GS.text: Golden State has Stephen Curry (26.5 mpg, oblique tear) out vs SAC tonight; Yaxel Lendeborg (31.7, illness) is questionable and Porzingis is not with the team, NBA 11:30 AM ET report.

DET.text: Detroit played without Cade Cunningham (34.9 mpg, right knee soreness), Duncan Robinson (30.6, quad) and Jalen Duren in the 11/24 win at ORL; Duren is practicing in the G League.

IND.text: Indiana recalled Tyrese Haliburton (33.0 mpg, hamstring, 11 games missed) from G League practice on 11/24 as he nears a return (Forbes via ESPN).

LAL.text: JJ Redick said the Lakers are optimistic Austin Reaves (35.2 mpg, heel, 4 games missed) returns Friday vs San Antonio (LakersNation via ESPN).

TOR.text: Toronto's RJ Barrett (34.1 mpg, right hamstring strain) is out and re-evaluated in two weeks from 11/19; Kawhi Leonard (knee) has begun on-court work (ClutchPoints via ESPN).

SAC.text: Sacramento's Zach LaVine (32.9 mpg, right knee soreness) was downgraded to questionable at GS tonight on the NBA's 4:30 PM ET report; Ben Simmons is out.
